interpretation: Masking peer gates sharply harms this frozen policy, but holding the first eligible peer latent preserves its aggregate win rate. No aggregate gain from refreshing peer latents was observed in this100-seed block. This is not an equivalence result or a retrained baseline comparison: the current own query, local observation history, legal actions and ordinary visibility gates remain adaptive in hold mode; zero coordination input is also a distribution shift. The matched trained IPPO endpoint remains81/100wins versus DMS56/100.
